name: CNC Cutting
description: Are you interested in CNC cutting? Become a member and enjoy affordable access to our professional-quality machine and training courses!

benefits.title: Training Courses
benefits.description: Access comprehensive training courses to learn CNC operation, safety, and best practices for getting the most out of our equipment.

benefits.title: Large 4'x8' CANCAM CNC Router
benefits.description: Work with our spacious CANCAM C2-48 LT CNC router, featuring a 49" x 98"x 12" working area, enabling you to tackle large-scale projects with ease.

benefits.title: Professional Speed and Precision
benefits.description: Experience professional-grade speed and precision with a rugged, vibration-reducing design, state-of-the-art Masso controls, and a 6HP spindle that achieves speeds up to 24,000 RPM and IPM feed rate up to 1200w. Our advanced spoilboard with threaded inserts allows for speedy and precise material hold-down.

benefits.title: Versatile Material Cutting
benefits.description: Cut wood and plastic with our CNC router, giving you flexibility to work with the materials best suited for your projects.
benefits.footnote: Our machine can also cut Aluminum but requires additional tooling and special approval.

benefits.title: Affordable Machine Time
benefits.description: Access professional CNC cutting at an affordable machine time rate, making precision manufacturing accessible for all project budgets.
